title: Better than anticipated
text: I was welcomed and surprised with my new craft of the mosaic tray. I started last night. I’m so delighted to get my creative juices flowing again after being so dormant. I love it and look forward to see what design my mind will create with the tiles. It’s definitely more than I expected so I’m grateful and happy to work on a project especially because I’m limited on how much I can do at a time due to health problems. I love it! Thank you!
label: positive
